title: Real Girl
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Hikari Tsutsui, an otaku shunned by classmates, is paired for pool-cleaning duty with Iroha, a popular girl with a troublemaker reputation, who asks him out. Though he dislikes her at first, he agrees to try dating, knowing she will move away in six months. The relationship pulls him out of isolation as both face friends, rivals and later Iroha's serious illness.
life_message: Opening up to real people, and standing by them, is worth the awkwardness and risk.

content.note: Iroha's brain tumor, surgery and amnesia (Wikipedia; AniList Tragedy, Amnesia tags).
Teen dating; Iroha rumored to be 'easy with boys' and has past experience (Kodansha blurb; MU tags); Kodansha rates 13+.
Social isolation, bullying and an inferiority complex (Wikipedia; MU Bullying, Inferiority Complex).
